entry.title: Characterizing Faults in Agentic AI: A Taxonomy of Types, Symptoms, and Root Causes
entry.summary: Agentic AI systems combine LLM reasoning with external tool invocation. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of failure modes across 40 open-source agentic-AI repositories and derive taxonomies of fault types, symptoms, and root causes for coding agents.

entry.title: Guardrails for LLM Coding Agents: Detecting Scope Creep and Fabrication
entry.summary: We propose a supervision framework for LLM coding agents that detects scope creep and fabrication of nonexistent APIs in real time. Our guardrails system catches failure modes such as prompt injection and hallucination across Claude Code and Codex traces.

entry.title: Diffusion Models for Music and Image Generation in Fashion Design
entry.summary: We present a new diffusion-based pipeline for image generation and music synthesis tailored to fashion industry workflows. Our blockchain-backed NFT marketplace integration is also discussed.

entry.title: A Lightweight Static Analysis Helper
entry.summary: This paper proposes a lint helper for code execution traces.
